capabilities: Open files, web pages, and periodic notes from configurable buttons
Replace new tabs with the Synaptic View dashboard
Display incomplete daily note task counts as badges on buttons
Browse and open daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly notes via a mini calendar
Open files in edit mode in a split pane via Cmd/Ctrl+click
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a graph of note connections; it is a configurable launcher dashboard shown in place of new tabs.
extras: Desktop-only and requires Obsidian v1.8.0 or higher; community plugin submission is still pending, so installation is currently manual. Some websites (e.g., Google, YouTube) block iframe embedding and cannot be opened via the Web button type.
problem: Users build homepage notes with Dataview queries, internal links, and CSS workarounds that need constant maintenance and scrolling to find anything.

relations.evidence: Week, Month, Quarter, and Year require the Periodic Notes plugin.
Calendar icons used in this plugin are adapted from the Periodic Notes plugin by Liam Cain
relations.plugin: Periodic Notes plugin by Liam Cain

summary: Configurable dashboard that can replace new tabs, offering buttons that open files, web pages, periodic notes, and a mini calendar.
